svg.title: Figure A4-7: Deployment Diagram - Demonstrated Prototype Execution Environment

g.text: Figure A4-7: Deployment Diagram - Demonstrated Prototype Execution Environment
Design differences: (1) one host with two processes instead of a three-container
stack; (2) H2 + local folder instead of managed PostgreSQL + object storage;
(3) AI in-process instead of a separately deployed service. The Compose profile
in the repository shows the intended production shape.
